messages:
Maya R.: Heads-up — converted a HF repo (llama-3-small) and evals show generation stalls; seems specials missing (</s> / <pad>).
Samir K.: Which tokenizer files were present in the model archive? tokenizer.json or tokenizer_config.json?
Maya R.: Only tokenizer.json (fast) + merges + vocab.bpe. converter logs show it tried to read tokenizer_config.json and then created an empty special_tokens_map.
convert-bot: conversion run 2143650000 completed with warnings: missing tokenizer_config.json; special_tokens_map not found.
Cheng Li: This is the fast vs slow mismatch we've been hitting. Our converter currently prefers tokenizer_config.json and assumes slow-tokenizer layout for specials. If only tokenizer.json exists the converter should parse that instead.
Leo S.: Also worth checking chat_template references — some templates expect <|endoftext|> vs </s>, which compounds the issue when specials are absent.
Samir K.: I can make a small fallback: if tokenizer_config.json missing, load tokenizer.json and synthesize tokenizer_config fields (special_tokens_map, bos/eos/pad). Will push a patch.
Ava P.: Can we add a unit test with a minimal HF package that only contains tokenizer.json? We keep regressing on that case.
Maya R.: Please do. I already have a failing prompt set from the conv-bench where perplexity jumped ~25% and stop tokens never triggered. I'll drop the failing prompt in the eval PR.
Samir K.: Quick patch idea:
```python
if os.path.exists(path / 'tokenizer_config.json'):
    cfg = load_json('tokenizer_config.json')
elif os.path.exists(path / 'tokenizer.json'):
    cfg = synthesize_from_fast(tokenizer_json_path)
    # copy special_tokens_map into cfg if present in tokenizer.json
```
Cheng Li: Make sure synthesize_from_fast also normalizes token names (eos vs end_of_text) and writes them into converter metadata so runtime uses the canonical names.
Samir K.: Will include normalization + small integration test. Planning PR #3872 for converter and another for CI eval set.
Ava P.: :thumbsup: Add a note in model-onboarding checklist: prefer tokenizer.json when only fast artifacts present, and verify chat_template tokens.
convert-bot: deployed converter patch at 2143654800 (tag v0.9.12) — run conversion again and report if any models still fail.
Maya R.: Re-ran conversion with v0.9.12; specials are present now but one model still maps <eos> -> <|endoftext|> in chat_template.json. I'll open a tiny follow-up to normalize templates.
Leo S.: FYI I'll scan recent imports for other repos that only ship tokenizer.json and add them to the onboarding queue.
Samir K.: Thanks everyone — will merge PR + tests today.
Maya R.: Thanks, feels good to have a deterministic fallback path.
